description: First real ticket against the 01-greenfield baseline. Simulates an ADO fetch (no live ticket exists) for a new admin screen that needs a Table component that doesn't exist yet, and directly triggers the large_components_and_page_patterns gap recorded during init. Tests the reuse-vs-exception extension workflow and the readiness-blocker logic for undefined states.

ticket.title: Add a "Manage Users" screen showing existing users in a table
ticket.description: Admins need a screen listing all users in the system (name, email, role, status) so they can review who has access before inviting new people. This is the first real screen in the app.
acceptance_criteria: Table showing name, email, role, status columns for all users
Status shown as a visual indicator (active/invited/disabled)
Empty state when no users exist yet
Responsive down to mobile width (single-column stacked view acceptable)

behaviors: flags baseline.gaps overlap as a first-class finding, not a footnote
treats undefined error/permission states as blockers, not advisories
asks before assuming reuse vs. ticket-scoped exception
searches Figma/repo before proposing a new component
implements and validates only the approved extension, not the full ticket
adds the extension to baseline.json components with source referencing the ticket
persists findings and decisions via ticket upsert (schema-valid)
ticket validate passes at end of run
